description: Shared cases for core accountabilityText: the copy-pasteable log-entry message. `when` is already-formatted local time, so both cores produce identical strings.

cases.name: the wording the user asked for
cases.expect: As of 9/20/26, 12:24:58 PM CDT my blood sugar is 170. I am eating something with 59 carbs and so am giving myself 7 units of fast acting insulin.

cases.name: one unit is singular
cases.expect: As of 1/2/26, 8:00:00 AM CST my blood sugar is 96. I am eating something with 15 carbs and so am giving myself 1 unit of fast acting insulin.

cases.name: fractional dose and carbs keep their decimals, trailing zeros do not
cases.expect: As of 3/4/26, 6:15:00 PM CST my blood sugar is 210. I am eating something with 42.5 carbs and so am giving myself 0.5 units of fast acting insulin.

cases.name: carbs round to one decimal
cases.expect: As of 3/4/26, 6:15:00 PM CST my blood sugar is 120. I am eating something with 59 carbs and so am giving myself 6.25 units of fast acting insulin.

cases.name: a zero dose is stated, never dropped
cases.expect: As of 5/1/26, 9:30:00 AM CDT my blood sugar is 88. I am eating something with 12 carbs and so am not giving myself any fast acting insulin.

cases.name: no dose recorded yet
cases.expect: As of 5/1/26, 9:30:00 AM CDT my blood sugar is 140. I am eating something with 30 carbs and have not recorded a dose yet.

cases.name: no BG on the entry
cases.expect: As of 5/1/26, 9:30:00 AM CDT I do not have a blood sugar reading. I am eating something with 30 carbs and so am giving myself 3 units of fast acting insulin.

cases.name: nothing recorded but the time
cases.expect: As of 5/1/26, 9:30:00 AM CDT I do not have a blood sugar reading. I am eating something with 0 carbs and have not recorded a dose yet.
